name: rerun_checks
description: Ask the CI app that reported a check run to run it again. Use it after checks_read shows a failure that looks like infrastructure trouble or a flaky test, not a problem in the change; investigate instead of re-running a check the change breaks or one whose re-run failed too. target takes the same shapes as checks_read. A run target re-requests that one run. A pull_request, commit, or suite target re-requests every run there that checks_read lists in failing and whose app declared it re-requestable (isRerequestable), at most 20 per call. Origin re-requests a run only when it is completed, is the latest run of its check, and is on the current head of an open pull request, with one re-request outstanding per run at a time. rerequested lists the runs this call re-requested: each reads status rerequested, which is pending and blocks a merge that requires it, until its app posts a new run, so follow it with checks_read. skipped lists the failing runs this call did not re-request, each with a message and a reason: not_rerequestable when its app does not accept re-runs, otherwise the error category Origin refused it with. truncated means the lists leave failing runs out; call again while calls keep re-requesting runs. For a run target, a refusal is the tool's error: not_found, or conflict when the run is still running, its app does not accept re-runs, it already has a re-request outstanding, or it is not on the current head of an open pull request. Other targets stop at a refusal that would repeat for every run, such as a permission or quota error or a commit that is not the current head of an open pull request; it is the tool's error when nothing was re-requested. Needs repository contents write, the same access as pushing.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

number.description: Pull request number, for a pull_request target

sha.description: Commit SHA, for a commit target

checkSuiteId.description: Check suite id, for a suite target

checkRunId.description: Check run id, for a run target
